note: System-level events for the buildout timeline. Every entry is checkable against the cited source; nothing here is inferred.

events.en: The Trans-Canada Highway Act is assented to on 10 December. Ottawa will pay half the cost of new construction, up to $150 million in all, and the highway is to be finished by December 1956.
events.zh: 《横加公路法》于 12 月 10 日获御准。联邦承担新建工程费用的一半，总额以 1.5 亿加元为限，公路须于 1956 年 12 月前建成。

events.en: Ontario, Manitoba, British Columbia, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan and Alberta sign their Trans-Canada agreements at the conference table on 25 April. New Brunswick follows on 27 May and Newfoundland on 23 June. Nova Scotia says it will sign later; Quebec declines.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，安大略、马尼托巴、不列颠哥伦比亚、爱德华王子岛、萨斯喀彻温与艾伯塔在会议桌上签署横加公路协议。新不伦瑞克于 5 月 27 日、纽芬兰于 6 月 23 日相继签署。新斯科舍表示日后再签，魁北克拒签。

events.en: By 21 June almost all the signing provinces have federal approval for contracts, and $11.2 million of work has been started.
events.zh: 至 6 月 21 日，已签约的省份几乎都获得了联邦对工程合同的批准，已开工的工程金额达 1,120 万加元。

events.en: The first work in the national parks: a bridge over the Bow River near Lake Louise station and about eight miles of grading on the Banff–East Gate section.
events.zh: 国家公园路段首批工程：路易斯湖车站附近的弓河大桥，以及班夫至东门段约八英里的路基工程。

events.en: Parliament amends the Trans-Canada Highway Act in June. The federal ceiling rises from $150 million to $250 million, Ottawa pays 90 per cent on a tenth of each province's mileage to close the worst gaps, and the completion date moves to 31 December 1960.
events.zh: 6 月，国会修订《横加公路法》：联邦出资上限由 1.5 亿加元提高到 2.5 亿加元；为补上最差的缺口，联邦对各省十分之一的里程承担 90% 费用；完工期限推迟到 1960 年 12 月 31 日。

events.en: A second amendment to the Trans-Canada Highway Act, passed in March, adds $100 million to the federal contribution.
events.zh: 3 月通过的《横加公路法》第二次修正案，为联邦出资再增 1 亿加元。

events.en: A third amendment in June raises federal funds under the Trans-Canada Highway Act to $400 million and extends the construction period by three years. The agreements now call for a paved highway across Canada by 31 May 1964.
events.zh: 6 月的第三次修正案将《横加公路法》项下的联邦资金提高到 4 亿加元，并将施工期延长三年。各项协议改为要求在 1964 年 5 月 31 日前建成横贯全国的铺装公路。

events.en: The Trans-Canada Highway is officially opened on 3 September, once the last major gap in the mountains has closed. It can be driven end to end for the first time, but construction is still going on in a number of sections: this is an opening, not a completion.
events.zh: 山区最后一处主要缺口闭合后，横加公路于 9 月 3 日正式通车，首次可以全程贯通驾驶。但多个路段仍在施工：这是通车，而非完工。

events.en: President Eisenhower signs the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956 on 29 June. It raises the planned system to 41,000 miles, sets nationwide design standards, and fixes the federal share of construction at 90 percent.
events.zh: 艾森豪威尔总统于 6 月 29 日签署《1956 年联邦公路资助法》。该法将系统规划里程提高到 41,000 英里，制定全国统一设计标准，并将联邦承担的建设费用比例定为 90%。
events.source: FHWA, The Dwight D. Eisenhower System of Interstate and Defense Highways, Part I

events.en: AASHO adopts the numbering plan still in use: even numbers run east–west and odd numbers north–south, both rising from the south and west, with three digits marking a loop or spur off a parent route.
events.zh: 美国州公路工作者协会通过沿用至今的编号规则：偶数为东西向、奇数为南北向，编号均自南向北、自西向东递增；三位数则表示由主线派生的环线或支线。

events.en: The first Interstate Cost Estimate submitted to Congress puts the price of the system at $37.6 billion, of which $34.0 billion would be federal. Fourteen more estimates follow over the next 33 years.
events.zh: 首份《州际公路造价估算》提交国会，估计系统造价 376 亿美元，其中联邦承担 340 亿美元。此后 33 年间又提交了十四份估算。
events.source: FHWA, Interstate System cost estimates reported to Congress, 1958–1991

events.en: President George H. W. Bush signs Public Law 101-427 on 15 October, renaming the network the Dwight D. Eisenhower System of Interstate and Defense Highways.
events.zh: 老布什总统于 10 月 15 日签署第 101-427 号公法，将该路网更名为「德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔州际及国防公路系统」。

events.en: The final Interstate Cost Estimate reports a total of $128.9 billion, with a federal share of $114.3 billion. It covers only the 42,795 miles built under the Interstate Construction programme, and excludes the turnpikes folded into the system.
events.zh: 最后一份《州际公路造价估算》报告总造价 1,289 亿美元，其中联邦承担 1,143 亿美元。该估算仅涵盖在州际公路建设计划下修建的 42,795 英里，不含并入系统的收费公路。

events.en: The Glenwood Canyon section of I-70 opens to traffic on 14 October, completing the original Interstate System. The 12.5-mile stretch of viaducts, bridges and tunnels through a 3,000-foot-deep gorge cost $490 million in 1992 dollars.
events.zh: I-70 格伦伍德峡谷段于 10 月 14 日通车，原定的州际公路系统就此建成。这段 12.5 英里的公路穿越 3,000 英尺深的峡谷，由高架桥、桥梁与隧道构成，以 1992 年币值计造价 4.9 亿美元。
events.source: FHWA Public Roads, March/April 2004; Colorado DOT

events.en: Interstate Construction funds are authorised for the last time, through fiscal year 1996. In all, federal-aid legislation had authorised $119 billion toward the federal share.
events.zh: 州际公路建设专项资金最后一次获得授权，期限至 1996 财年。联邦公路资助立法累计为联邦出资部分授权 1,190 亿美元。

events.en: The Pennsylvania Turnpike interchange opens at Bristol Township on 22 September, closing the gap that had split I-95 since New Jersey cancelled the Somerset Freeway in 1983.
events.zh: 9 月 22 日，布里斯托尔镇的宾州收费高速互通立交通车，补上了自 1983 年新泽西州取消萨默塞特高速公路计划以来 I-95 的断口。

events.en: The system stands at 46,876 miles, including roughly 2,900 miles of turnpikes that were folded in rather than built new.
events.zh: 系统总里程为 46,876 英里，其中约 2,900 英里是并入的既有收费公路，而非新建路段。
events.source: FHWA Interstate Frequently Asked Questions; FHWA Route Log and Finder List, January 2026
